lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: You found the hive. Good. The Queen's jelly is gone.

lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: Without it the bees rage, and the {C119} road stays shut.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He sniffs a red feather on the floor.)

lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: Someone stole it. Help me get it back, or no one leaves Honey Town.
